title: Unit of Work Pattern
description: Coordinate multiple repositories in a single transaction.

data.text:
**Unit of Work**

Maintains a list of objects affected by a business transaction and coordinates writing changes and concurrency resolution.
`DbContext` is itself a Unit of Work. `SaveChangesAsync()` commits all tracked changes in one transaction.

data.title: Over-Engineering
data.text: For simple apps, injecting DbContext directly is fine. Introduce Unit of Work when you have multiple repositories and complex transactions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Unit of Work batches changes into one transaction
DbContext already acts as a Unit of Work
data.takeaway: Next, we'll reduce dependencies with the Mediator pattern.
